title: Tenant Canary generic publisher bootstrap contract

phases.objective: Align the Tenant Canary bootstrap regression with the canonical shared CI Evidence PR Publisher after retirement of the specialized Hostinger publisher workflow.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The regression validates the current generic publisher, routing registry, exact artifact binding, bounded permissions, and retirement of the obsolete specialized workflow.
steps: Load the Tenant Canary workflow and shared CI evidence publisher from the repository tree.
Verify exact-head checkout, read-only PR-head permissions, canonical artifact identity, and secret-free report enforcement.
Verify the shared publisher subscribes to Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard and invokes the Hostinger evidence handler.
Verify routing points the Hostinger route to CI Evidence PR Publisher and specialized_publishers remains empty.
Reject restoration of the retired hostinger-ci-evidence-pr-publisher workflow.
assertions: The canonical publisher identity is CI Evidence PR Publisher.
The publisher is triggered by completed workflow_run events and checks out trusted main without persisted credentials.
Permissions remain actions:read, contents:read, issues:write, and pull-requests:write.
Hostinger Tenant Canary artifacts remain bound to the exact workflow_run id and source head SHA.
The specialized publisher workflow remains absent and the specialized publisher registry remains empty.
No migration, SQL, deployment, Production mutation, provider dispatch, credential access, protected-branch bypass, or force push occurs.

phases.objective: This change repairs a repository regression contract and does not operate a live Hostinger runtime.
Failure and stale-evidence handling remain covered by the existing canonical publisher regressions.
No live canary execution is performed by this test-only correction.
No deployment, migration, provider, or Production authority is introduced.
